;also contains Journal update for killing all three nords in quest CO_8a

short scuirass
short sgreaves
short slpauld
short srpauld
short slbracer
short srbracer

short busy

short nolore

if ( busy == 1 )
	if ( currentday != day )
		set currentday to day
		set localdayspassed to ( localdayspassed + 1 )
	endif
endif

if ( OnPCHitMe == 1 )
	"Hidar"->SetFight 100
	"Hidar"->StartCombat Player
	"Graring"->SetFight 100
	"Graring"->StartCombat Player
endif


End ColonyAenar

begin PasheevaSchedule

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
  return
endif

if ( player->GetLOS "1Pasheeva" == 0 )
  if ( "1Pasheeva"->GetHealth > 0 )
  if ( GameHour > 19 )
    "1Pasheeva"->disable
  elseif ( GameHour < 5 )
    "1Pasheeva"->disable
  elseif ( GetCurrentWeather > 3 )
    "1Pasheeva"->disable
  else
    "1Pasheeva"->enable
  endif
  endif
endif

end

begin TemplarTailguardScript

if ( GetPCRank "Imperial Legion" >= 5 )
	if GetItemCount "templar_tail" == 0
		AddItem "templar_tail" 1
	else
		return
else
	return
	endif
endif

end
